title: Rate the Limit
scenario: An internal agent can call a business API as fast as it can generate requests. The endpoint currently has no rate control.
objective: Implement bounded per-identity request limits and a small burst allowance suitable for an automated client.
ai_native_dimension: An agentic client generates machine-speed traffic; the learner must design limits that preserve business use without allowing unbounded requests.

verification.message: rate limit must be per identity

aar_questions: What was the security problem in Rate the Limit and what objective evidence proved it?
What was the risk if it remained unresolved?
What did you change and why?
How did you verify the result independently of AI output?
Where did AI help, where was it wrong/incomplete, and what remained your responsibility?
